messages:
alex: rolling up kernel + q8 quant profile to canary slice at 22:00 UTC, need quick sanity plan
maria: on it. i'll take smoke on slice-14. checklist?
sam: i'll own rollback readiness + metrics watch. will pre-create rollback PR and keep it ready :white_check_mark:
alex: thanks. smoke steps: 1) deploy small traffic, 2) run 3 short prompts, 3) check p99 latency and mem OOM logs
maria: quick commands i'll run:
```bash
kubectl -n rwinference rollout status ds/runtime-canary-slice-14
curl -s -X POST https://canary.ing/rpc -d '{"input":"translate hello"}' | jq
enginectl metrics --slice=14 --tail 60
```
sam: i'll enable alerting temporarily:
- p99 latency > 300ms for 5m -> notify #eng-runtime
- error rate > 0.5% -> rollback
deploy-bot: scheduled deployment: slice-14 -> kernel v2.9.1 + quant q8 @ 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z. owner: alex. dry-run passed.
lee: heads-up: model serving infra will evict warm KV caches on this rollout. warm-up script in ops repo helps restore.
anya: can we avoid full eviction? maybe keep previous kernel on standby?
alex: good call. sam keeps a warm pool ready as fallback. rollback plan: apply previous deployment tag `runtime-2.9.0-canary` then run warm-up.
maria: i'll run smoke in a separate window and paste results here. ping me when deploy starts :eyes:
sam: i'll watch telemetry and have rollback PR linked. if anything > threshold, i'll trigger and post ETA
alex: target: 15m smoke window post-deploy. if all green, promote canary to 3 additional slices next day. otherwise rollback and investigate
maria: got it. i'll also run 2 quick eval prompts for correctness drift
anya: tagging docs: docs/rollouts/canary-checklist.md updated with q8 note
alex: thanks everyone. will post start banner 5m before.
